minutes.headline: Commission approved several filings, put up to $20,000 of Timber Rights Fund match toward a trails grant, and heard the Hickory Hills lake report.
minutes.summary: The Conservation Commission continued the 23 Cove Road greenhouse enforcement matter for two weeks and heard Hickory Hills Landowners' annual lake report. It issued a negative determination for 336 Arbor Street, approved two notices of intent (Crocker Avenue sewer line, Sunset Lane retaining walls with extra shrubs), and voted to support a Mass Trails grant with a local match. It also approved two purchase orders and referred another encroachment to Town Counsel.

attendees.role: presenter, engineer for Crocker Avenue applicant
presenter, engineer for Sunset Lane applicant and grant consultant

public_comment.topic: Chair asked for public comment at start of meeting; no one raised a hand.
Owner of 23 Cove Road said they will take the greenhouse down, accept the new enforcement order, and asked for a two-week continuance to gather new information.
Applicant for 336 Arbor Street described tree removal in the buffer and asked how to make it right.

votes.motion: Negative determination on the request for determination of applicability for 336 Arbor Street (Walker)
Approve the notice of intent for one Crocker Avenue sewer line replacement with standard order of conditions
Approve the notice of intent at 406 Sunset Lane with standard order of conditions plus eight additional shrubs placed as worked out with the conservation administrator
Support the Mass Trails grant and pledge up to the local match from the Timber Rights Fund
Purchase order to MRPC for trail maps from the Timber Rights Fund
Purchase order to Smart Sign for trail signs
Refer the 26 Malpas Road encroachment to Town Counsel

budget_items.what_was_said: Total grant request was stated with a required 20 percent local match, shown as coming from the general fund in earlier talks. The commission then pledged its match from the Timber Rights Fund.
figures_as_heard: a little less than sixty thousand dollars

budget_items.topic: MRPC GIS trail map purchase order
budget_items.what_was_said: Purchase order for trail maps from the Timber Rights Fund.

budget_items.topic: Hollis Road heating system cleaning invoice
budget_items.what_was_said: Invoice for annual cleaning was said to be already authorized at a prior meeting.
Applicant's engineer said fees were calculated by category for the walls and the addition, and DEP had suggested considering an additional fee.
A grant to the snow riders was awarded, with matching funds provided as labor.

decisions.decision: 23 Cove Road matter will be placed first on the agenda again in two weeks (February 1) as a courtesy; a new enforcement order covers just the greenhouse.
Administrator will create a letterhead notice that the earlier Cove Road enforcement is closed, to be placed on file.
Snow Riders may add protective decking to the Peter Sharpentier Bridge using leftover lumber; no motion needed.
Staff and commissioners will review prior minutes and records for 205 Sunset Lane before any hearing; applicant to receive copies of correspondence if found.
Chair will arrange a spring bird inventory at the Hunting Hill hayfield with local birders before any bridge or mowing work.

what_happened.line: The Conservation Commission voted to support a Mass Trails grant and pledge the required local match from the Timber Rights Fund.
It approved two notices of intent: a Crocker Avenue sewer line replacement and 406 Sunset Lane, the latter with eight added shrubs.
It voted a negative determination on the request for determination of applicability for 336 Arbor Street.
It approved two purchase orders, trail maps from the Timber Rights Fund and trail signs, and referred the 26 Malpas Road encroachment to Town Counsel.
The 23 Cove Road greenhouse enforcement matter was continued two weeks, to February 1.

why_it_matters: The trails grant match and the trail map and sign purchases draw on the Timber Rights Fund rather than the general fund, so they do not appear in the tax-supported town budget.
The grant minutes first described the match as coming from the general fund and then pledged it from the Timber Rights Fund, so a resident following the grant should check which fund finally pays.
watch_next: February 1: the 23 Cove Road greenhouse enforcement matter returns first on the Commission's agenda.
The 205 Sunset Lane enforcement matter, which reached no resolution, is to be reviewed against prior minutes and records before any hearing.
